items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: so from there I went to - to Barroso, with The Agabama.

ctx.x: She thought you were going to quit.
Yes, so she brought somebody to play, a good one, Panchito, Panchito El Moro, good maraca player; so from there I went to - to Barroso, with The Agabama.
Abelardo Barroso, the vocalist, he had a group called La Agabama?
